rationale: Junior industrial designer for light boxes and ceiling products in Rhino, SolidWorks and Illustrator is product design, outside civil engineering.
A recent graduate or final-year industrial design student is wanted; Marc's qualifications are civil.
caution: Outside civil engineering; the industrial design degree is a stated requirement.
mandatory_unmet: "A degree in Industrial Design (or about to complete one)" (Marc holds a civil engineering degree and a civil construction design advanced diploma)
title: Junior Industrial Designer
screening_questions: Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
What's your expected annual base salary?
How many years' experience do you have as an Industrial Designer?
How much notice are you required to give your current employer?
Do you have Schematic Design experience?
